reviews.title: Great app but synching struggles
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for well over a year and love it! It’s great motivation and great at tracking associated habits with low/no alcohol. Lately (from late November 2025, and especially this January) the math of it seems very off—I’m doing Dry January but it says I’ve only been dry for one day and not 19, i.e.. So I can’t give it 5 stars but certainly would do 4.8 if that were an option. Thank you for making this available in the US!

reviews.title: Great Support Tool
reviews.text: This is a fantastic app for not only for those trying to modify their drinking for whatever reasons, but for educating themselves as well. It’s non-judgmental and keeps you motivated to check-in by really thinking about why you’re drinking. It gives the opportunity to jot daily notes and keep track of how your day went, which goes a long way to assessing how alcohol is affecting you in ways you might now otherwise notices. It also has great links for NA beers, health articles, and many other informative pieces that can help you decide what works best for you.   Besides that, the app updates and tech support are fantastic and quick to answer and fix and issues. Great job!

reviews.title: Helpful
reviews.text: I found it very helpful to read the daily articles. They gave good strategies for staying on track and remembering all the good things I am doing for myself by not drinking. I appreciated the non-judgmental tone and encouragement. Even though I didn’t think of myself as a big drinker, it was challenging to cut out alcohol completely. Maybe the challenge was more about overcoming the feeling of defiance about having to say no to myself than it was about the actual drinking itself. I enjoyed reading the personal stories that people shared. I found them to be very inspirational. In addition, I like the suggestions about planning for the future after January. I might not have thought to do this on my own. Thanks for providing this great public service.

reviews.title: Dry January
reviews.text: My husband and I are doing dry January.  I found this app very helpful.  I look forward to seeing the daily information in my email.  Best of all, the end of the night when it asks if I had a dry day? I get to play an active role in my staying dry.  I highly recommend the app and doing Dry January.

reviews.title: Almost perfect!
reviews.text: If it just had a way to allow individuals to track the physical changes (with pictures), it would help to push reinforce the positives of being alcohol free.

reviews.title: Easy to Use / Motivating
reviews.text: I found about the Try Dry app on Reddit, and I and so glad I did. I started using it for Dry January in 2024 and used it almost consistently throughout the year. It’s very easy to go in and click if you “stayed dry” or if you “drank as planned”. It’s motivating to see all the days pile up. I enjoy scrolling back to last year and looking at my consumption and I’m proud of how far I’ve come and the relationship shift I’ve had with alcohol and I would like to give credit to the app. I’m not completely “dry” and I still drink often throughout the year but it helps hold me accountable to reflect on my habits with drinking. The emails throughout January have also been helpful, with little tips and motivating stories! I recommend this app to those who want to learn more about their relationship with alcohol.

reviews.title: Game Changer
reviews.text: Just do it.

reviews.title: Great for January, and beyond!
reviews.text: This app has been great. I started using it in late Dec 2024 and have carried on throughout Jan. The reminders are helpful, the emails motivate, and realizing the calories and money saved is a good extra nudge. I’d love to see more added like community connections, podcasts, etc. But it’s wonderful as is. Thanks for making me (and some friends) healthier and happier this January!

reviews.title: Disappointingly and disgustingly, it’s all bout ca$hing in from the app users
reviews.text: Everything is converted into money.  Your baseline, your goals, your net change in habits.  The app nudges you to donate every chance it gets.  It is super materialistic, and overwhelmingly gives off vibes that it’s not very concerned about your health.  You could even say it’s miscategorized as a health app.  Also, it feels rushed… everything is about the UK and pounds of sterling, even if you stay in setup that you live in another major country.  And if you try to change your existing complex goal that it took you minutes to configure, it doesn’t actually let you edit but you have to rebuild from scratch. Greed at its worst, don’t think for a second there’s anything altruistic about this app.

reviews.title: App locks up every few days
reviews.text: This app is a motivator to stay dry and it is easy to use. But the daily reminder asking,  Did You stay dry?, will lock up on my IPhone and IPad every few days.  This is frustrating of course. Hopefully your software engineers can work through the issues.

reviews.title: Recognizes You Are Human
reviews.text: Cheers from the US! This is the app I have been looking for to cut back drinking. I have tried a few others and they fell short in some way or the other. Many felt slapped together so they can charge a subscription fee and make some money off of you trying to be healthier. Others felt judgmental like I was being chastised if I slipped or had a drink at all. I like that this app is just very matter of fact. It gives the facts and details of how much doctors say is unhealthy. If you do have a drink, it’s not a big deal. You are treated no differently. You share your mood, how you feel, cravings, notes, and you move on. Tomorrow is another day. It helps me feel hopeful. That a slip up id just that, and I don’t have to dwell on it. I also quite appreciate that it differentiates between having a planned vs unplanned drink, because sometimes I do plan to have a beer with a friend and that is very different from drinking when I have no intention to. If all that weren’t enough, it celebrates your success with badges and missions! I feel good having not had a drink. It doesn’t feel like a slog. Thank you for creating this. It helps me be more cognizant of my drinking and I still feel like I’m a human being.

reviews.title: Insights not all that insightful
reviews.text: I like this app and it’s helping me cut back. But it seems the Insights page needs some work. For example, under “my drinking” I select explore, then select the last 30 days, but the total drinking days and total dry days add up to only 17.2 days. I’ve faithfully entered my drinking history for the last 30 days (and much longer) so I don’t understand why drinking+dry for the last 30 days doesn’t add up to a total of 30. Confusing

reviews.title: Make it work
reviews.text: There are so many ways to adapt the app to your specific goals. It’s easy to track drinking and spot patterns. It’s personal and private. It works for every kind of goal, be it cutting back or hitting a long addiction head on. The visual calendars shows your drinking rate, and that, for me, ends up leading to a greater awareness of my problematic areas. I can honestly say this app has made an improvement in how I make all kinds of choices in my life, including, but not exclusively, how I decide to drink or not drink. Thanks to all that keep this app going!

reviews.title: Game changer! Love this app!

reviews.title: Helps Stick to Goals
reviews.text: The app helps you visually identify drinking patterns—and set goals for desired behavior. Love that it reinforces healthy behavior with motivators like money and calories saved.

reviews.title: great app
reviews.text: very useful with lots of helpful resources, tips, and encouragement

reviews.title: Motivating
reviews.text:
I have been using the app since Dry Jan 2020 and have found it very helpful in cutting way back on my stubborn habit of rewarding myself after work with a beer or two. I have lost 12 pounds, upped my exercise time and most notably am sleeping soundly. 
Shout out to the developers who have addressed some of the early glitches that were a bit annoying but really never affected the usability of the app. The UK system of tracking units was unfamiliar to me, but once I understood it, it was so much more precise. I saw just how much of a difference there is between a 7% pint of beer and a 5.3% 12oz can of beer.  It is important to note the difference between a UK pint and US pint. 
Highly recommend the app. Thanks to AlcoholChange UK!

reviews.title: Excellent accountability tool!
reviews.text: I’ve been using the app for two or three years since my first dry January. It helps me keep consumption lower and keeps me honest. The stories and added tools like the test are all so well thought out and developed. Thanks!!

reviews.title: Great app!

reviews.title: Great app and a big help!
reviews.text:
I am very grateful that this app was made and available for my Dry January attempt. I am happy to say that I was successful and this app was a great benefit and contribution to that effort. The (optional) emails that I received during January were extremely helpful and the blogs were great as well. Just an all-around great experience through this app. 

Being able to see my journey, the units and money saved, and the ability to journal was actually very helpful. 

So I am continuing to use the app for my next goal, an alcohol free Lent. Thank-you to the developers of the app. You were a great help to me.
